versions.changelog:
PowPow Financing Plan - Investor Challenge v1.2.3

- Introduces an interactive Q&A mode triggered by PowPow-specific funding/investment interest, featuring 13 personalized questions to build an investing-style portrait.
- Adds memory-based personalized openings with explicit user consent, supplementing question choices and responses.
- Establishes strict activation rules: skill triggers only for PowPow + funding discussions, never for general industry/job/research queries.
- Launches a badge system: each answered question grants a badge, which can be used in the PowPow product (e.g., create/renew digital humans).
- Integrates an optional email flow with redacted preview for contact, with all fields optional.
- Ensures a standardized, positive, non-scored response for each investor answer—focused on fit, not evaluation.
